report.explanation: Alert cites checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 71ms, zero dependency timeouts, and an INFO 200 log. A single gateway trace shows an ERROR calling payment at 967ms, suggesting downstream latency, but no payment or order telemetry is available to bound it. Insufficient evidence to name a root cause; hand off for downstream service data.
missing_evidence: Traces for order and payment services to confirm the failing downstream span and its error status
Payment service metrics (error rate, p95 latency, dependency timeouts) during the incident window
Order service metrics and logs to localize where the gateway call fails
Gateway error logs or error-level entries; only INFO 200 request_complete observed
Per-endpoint gateway error-rate and latency breakdown to reconcile alert with 0.0012 error rate and p95 71ms
